_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: V, W and TH in common words

items.native: Sprich V weich und stimmhaft, nicht wie F.
items.gloss_en: Say V soft and voiced, not like F.

items.native: W mit runden Lippen, nicht wie V.
items.gloss_en: W with round lips, not like V.

items.native: Zunge zwischen die Zähne, nicht S oder F.
items.gloss_en: Tongue between the teeth, not S or F.

items.native: Das T in der Mitte klingt weich.
items.gloss_en: The T in the middle sounds soft.

segments.text: Four words many people say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.caption: Sagst du diese 4 Wörter richtig? Bei “very” ist das V stimmhaft, bei “world” sind die Lippen rund, bei “three” steckt die Zunge zwischen den Zähnen, und in “water” klingt das T weich. Hör Carlos zu und sprich in der Pause nach. Übe mehr in der Lexkite-App.

en.caption: Do you say these 4 words correctly? In “very” the V is voiced, in “world” your lips are round, in “three” your tongue is between your teeth, and in “water” the T sounds soft. Listen to Carlos, then say each word in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
